How much blue light do Ocushield Screen protectors block?

Developed by qualified optometrists, our medically-rated screen protectors for smartphones and tablets effectively block up to 99% of harmful UV, blue light emissions between 300-400nm, and up to 54% of harmful blue light between 400-470nm.
This means you’re protected from harmful blue light and all of the nasty stuff that comes with it — such as headaches, tired eyes, sleepless nights and premature ageing.
